analysis.title: Regal Rexnord Corp. (RRX): First Take: 3Q26 beat driven by AMC, implied 4Q guide below expectations
key_insights: RRX 3Q26 adj. segment EBITDA was $351mn, $10mn above Visible Alpha consensus. The figure includes $14.7mn of IEEPA tariff refunds.
AMC drove the beat. AMC sales beat as RRX recognized $25mn in E-POD sales, and AMC margins ex-IEEPA were about 18.7%, implying 10-11% incrementals.
Daily orders were +5.7% y/y in 3Q. Segment orders were -4.9% at AMC, +9.6% at IPS and +12% at PES.
RRX narrowed its FY26 EPS guide to $10.60-$10.90 from $10.35-$10.85, raising the midpoint to $10.75 from $10.60. The guide includes $0.58 of IEEPA tariff refund benefit.
The guide raise comes mainly from a lower FY26 tax rate of about 20.8% versus about 21.5% before.
The updated FY26 guide implies about $333-$354mn of 4Q EBITDA versus consensus of $360mn, so the implied 4Q guide sits below expectations.
GS calls the print a mixed result and says the share trajectory depends on confidence in the outlook and the value creation framework.
3Q26 organic growth was +6.1% versus GS +3.6%. By segment: IPS -1.8% (GS -0.5%), PES +0.4% (GS +1%), AMC +25.2% (GS +13%).

market_movers.rationale: GS keeps a Buy and a $216 12-month target, based on 12x its Q5-Q8E EBITDA. The stock closed at $160.93 on 2 Nov 2026, implying 34.2% upside.

earnings_insights: RRX reported 3Q26 adj. cash EPS of $2.90 (reported, diluted cash EPS) versus GS estimate $2.54 and Visible Alpha consensus $2.63. 3Q25 actual was $2.51.
3Q26 reported total revenue was $1,588mn versus GS estimate $1,559mn and VA consensus $1,562mn, up 6% y/y.
3Q26 reported segment EBITDA was $351mn (22.1% margin) versus GS estimate $338.6mn and VA consensus $341mn. The reported figure includes $14.7mn of IEEPA tariff refunds.
3Q26 reported segment revenue: IPS $650mn (GS $661mn, VA $663mn), PES $438mn (GS $441mn, VA $440mn), AMC $501mn (GS $458mn, VA $462mn).
3Q26 reported segment EBITDA: IPS $169mn (26.0% margin), PES $86mn (19.7%), AMC $96mn (19.2%). Total EBIT was $220mn (13.8% margin) versus GS $200.4mn.
FY26 EPS guide narrowed to $10.60-$10.90 versus GS $10.50 and consensus $10.60 before the update. The guide includes $0.58 of IEEPA tariff refund benefit.
GS estimates: 4Q26E EPS $2.78 and 1Q27E EPS $2.92. FY26E EPS $10.50, FY27E $12.50 and FY28E $14.00.
risk_factors: Margin pressure in PES and AMC.
geopolitical: IEEPA tariff refunds of $14.7mn were included in RRX 3Q26 segment EBITDA, and FY26 EPS guidance includes $0.58 of refund benefit.

tension_points.bull_case: 3Q beat on AMC sales, EBITDA and EPS, daily orders +5.7% y/y, and a raised FY26 EPS guide midpoint to $10.75.
tension_points.bear_case: The guide raise is mostly a lower tax rate and includes $0.58 of IEEPA refund benefit. Implied 4Q EBITDA of about $333-$354mn is below the $360mn consensus.
tension_points.what_invalidates: A 4Q EBITDA outcome below the implied $333-$354mn guide range, or weak confidence in the outlook and value creation framework, would undercut the bull case.
